archiveTitle: Daily Brief | ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE: ACE COMBAT 8 details its first 10 campaign missions

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day teams with Liquid Death for a Chainsaw Flex reward running September 25 to November 30
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announced a Gears of War: E-Day collaboration with Liquid Death. In the United States, eligible Liquid Death Energy purchases through participating retailers from September 25 through November 30 can unlock an in-game content pack headlined by the Legendary animated Chainsaw Flex pose; limited collaboration merchandise also launched the same day.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary page was opened. The campaign dates, U.S.-only restriction, purchase path and Chainsaw Flex reward are bounded to that source.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire publication time converts to 00:00 Beijing time on September 26, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE: ACE COMBAT 8 details its first 10 campaign missions, four aircraft roles and squad support
entries.summary: After playing the first 10 campaign missions, Xbox Wire described four aircraft roles—Fighter, Multirole, Attacker and Electronic Warfare—alongside escort, bombing and air-to-air missions, progressive training missions and combat support from Joker Flight. The article lists an October 2 launch for Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The Xbox Wire primary hands-on article was opened. This copy uses only its concrete campaign, aircraft-role, training, squad-support and Xbox Series X|S release-date details, not the author's qualitative verdicts.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire publication time converts to 22:30 Beijing time on September 25, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE: ACE COMBAT 8 details its first-person story, with the player secretly inheriting the Wings of Theve title
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog explains that the silent player pilot becomes a central story character after Jan 'Rex' Cope is killed and secretly inherits his Wings of Theve call sign. Most cutscenes are presented from a first-person perspective, while DualSense haptics and frequent interactions with Joker Flight support the more intimate presentation.
entries.verification: The PlayStation Blog primary article was opened. This supplement is limited to story structure, character identity and PS5/DualSense details that are distinct from the already published Xbox hands-on entry.
entries.timeNote: The PlayStation Blog timestamp converts to 22:00 Beijing time on September 25, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Thank You 4 Playing launches on Steam January 8, 2027 with roughly 25% more content
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Libragames is expanding its formerly time-limited free deduction puzzle game for a paid Steam release on January 8, 2027. The Steam version changes the UI and logo, adds the boss Ghostman and two SNS characters, and increases the overall content by about 25%.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON article was opened; the release date, Steam version and added content are explicitly attributed to Libragames' September 25 announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 14:06 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE launches on Steam December 10 with flexible curved tracks and curved stations
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that ARTDINK announced A-Train 9 PRIME LINE for PC via Steam on December 10, 2026. The new version adds freely adjustable curved and graded track through the Flexible system, loop lines and curved stations, and supports importing custom rolling stock from A-Train 9 Train Construction.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON article was opened; the announcement, release date, platform and new rail/station features are explicitly relayed from ARTDINK.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 11:21 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt: The Witcher 3 expansion Melody of Remembrance hands-on shows Geralt investigating Dandelion's disappearance in a new region
entries.summary: At a TGS 2026 gameplay presentation, AUTOMATON saw the opening of The Witcher 3's new expansion, planned for 2027 and set in the new region Retten around Dandelion's disappearance. The same event also offered hands-on time with the September 29 Nintendo Switch 2 version of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report is used as a first-hand event report only for what its reporter saw in the expansion opening and the Switch 2 remaster demo.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 15:00 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Dutch consumer group moves toward Fortnite class action over spending mechanics aimed at minors
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Stichting Massaschade & Consument announced on September 24 that it is seeking a collective settlement with Epic Games over alleged unnecessary spending pressure on young Fortnite players, including refund and damages claims. Court proceedings have not started; a class action would follow only if a collective settlement is not reached.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened. The copy preserves the current pre-court settlement stage and does not elevate the separate €100 million estimate into a core fact.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 11:45 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Former Unicorn Overlord director Takashi Noma announces DAWNGAZER for PS5, Switch 2 and Steam in 2028
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Monochrome and Good Smile Company announced action RPG DAWNGAZER on September 25. It is being developed by Ignisphere Studio under former Vanillaware developer and Unicorn Overlord director/character designer Takashi Noma, with a 2028 release planned for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON article explicitly identifies DAWNGAZER, its team, lead creator, target platforms and 2028 window. The packet's automated subject key points to Unicorn Overlord; this decision corrects only that normalized subject using opened evidence.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 11:00 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Penguin Colony moves its PC release date to October 17
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that ORIGAME DIGITAL and Fellow Traveller changed the PC Steam launch of cosmic-horror adventure Penguin Colony to October 17. Players observe a 1939 Antarctic excavation from the perspective of a penguin.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report is limited to the announced October 17 date change, PC Steam platform and basic premise.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer page/feed timestamp converts to 15:19 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: 1998 FPS SiN returns on PC as SiN Reloaded
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that Nightdive Studios and Atari have released SiN Reloaded for PC, a full remaster of the 1998 FPS optimized for modern systems using the KEX Engine.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports the launch state, companies, PC platform, original release year and KEX Engine detail.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer page/feed timestamp converts to 19:24 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Open-world driving survival FPS Apocalypter launches on Steam
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that SawyerK Games released Apocalypter on Steam on September 24. The game combines open-world driving, survival and FPS elements in a post-apocalyptic wasteland around a customizable vehicle.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports the release date, Steam platform, developer and genre description.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer page/feed timestamp converts to 17:39 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Real-time shogi game ドパ将棋！ launches free in PC and mobile browsers
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that solo developer Keichi released ドパ将棋！ for free on September 23. It keeps most standard shogi piece rules but removes turns, letting both players move pieces in real time on PC and mobile browsers.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the free browser release, platforms and no-turn core rule.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 15:45 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Walls Were Built to Fall developer says wishlists reached 13,000; game targets up to one million simultaneous enemies
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Zoomy Cat Games announced 13,000 wishlists on September 23 for Walls Were Built to Fall. The PC Steam magic-defense FPS is planned for Q2 2027 and is built around battles with as many as one million enemies visible at once.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly attributes the 13,000-wishlist milestone to the developer and separately supports the one-million-enemy target and Q2 2027 window. Popularity language is omitted.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 12:19 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: DRAPLINE exits 15 months of Early Access with 25 new endings
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Vaka Game Magazine launched Kanao's DRAPLINE 1.0 for PC via Steam on September 24. The full release adds the DRAGON'S DISCIPLINE scenario and 25 endings after roughly one year and three months in Early Access.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays the full launch, Early Access duration, new scenario and 25 endings from the publisher announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON timestamp converts to 13:00 Beijing time on September 25, inside the fixed window.
